resources.string: Check links and senders with ScamShield servers. Only the sender, the links and the kind of warning signs are sent — not your message text.

When a message is confirmed as a scam, automatically send it, the other messages from that same sender, and the analysis to cyber-crime authorities and the organisation being imitated. Your other messages are never sent.
Also send the full text of incoming messages for better checks.
Auto-forward scam SMS to TRAI 1909 from my SIM (uses one SMS each time).
Automated checks can be wrong. A warning is not a legal finding.
